{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "adapter": {
    "id": "codex",
    "name": "Codex CLI",
    "evidence_grade": "D",
    "native_hook_status": "unverified",
    "end_to_end_verified": false,
    "config_targets": [
      "config.toml"
    ],
    "capture_fields": [
      "event",
      "session_id",
      "cwd",
      "tool_name",
      "timestamp"
    ],
    "features": [
      {
        "name": "config_toml",
        "status": "documented_unverified"
      },
      {
        "name": "hook_lifecycle",
        "status": "documented_unverified"
      }
    ],
    "not_claimed": [
      "automatic installation",
      "verified native hook",
      "restore or enforcement",
      "MCP proxy"
    ]
  },
  "hook_command": "anchor adapter capture --adapter codex --stdin --print",
  "native_config_file": "config.toml.fragment",
  "native_config": "# ANCHOR STATUS: UNVERIFIED documentation-only fragment.\n# Review before manual use. It does not install itself, restore, or block tool calls.\n[hooks]\npost_tool_use = \"anchor adapter capture --adapter codex --stdin --print\"\n",
  "installation": "manual_review_only",
  "does_not_overwrite_user_config": true,
  "does_not_restore_or_block": true
}
